name: 78748 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78748 (Austin) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78748 (Austin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78748 (Austin) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 77 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
